title: C24 performance probe final phase depended on Git checkout line endings

reproduction.error: Performance probe marker is absent from the baseline warmup factorio.log.
reproduction.observed: Factorio loaded the probe data stage and recorded all measured phase markers, but omitted the probe data-final-fixes stage and therefore emitted no final JSON marker.
reproduction.isolation: Replacing only the package-excluded data-final-fixes.lua working-tree bytes with either the tracked mixed-ending blob bytes or deterministic LF bytes made exact C21 and C24 probe-smoke loads pass.

root_cause.summary: The package-source and controller commits name the same normalized Git blob, but core.autocrlf materialized the frozen source clone as all-CRLF bytes while the controller checkout retained the blob's mixed endings. Factorio 2.1.12 omitted the all-CRLF probe final-fixes stage. The v5 planner already treats text identities as newline-normalized, but the execution overlay did not deterministically materialize those semantics.

regression_propositions: performance probe final-fixes text is materialized as UTF-8 without BOM and LF-only line endings
the overlay manifest binds campaign authority, canonical probe bytes, harness identity, source commit, and unchanged package-source identity
overlay changes are restricted to the two package-excluded governed paths
exact C21 and C24 probe-smoke loads both emit the final structured marker
schema-3 admission requires the exact campaign lane set, run policy, campaign digest, and harness digest

closure.proof_required: fresh exact paired performance measurement and complete C24 calibration under a new immutable context
